uncited: *   **Sampling Rate:** Determined by the image size and number of samples along each ray.
*   **Memory Limits:** The volume data must fit in the texture memory of the graphics system.
*   **Gradient Accuracy:** The quality of shading depends on the accuracy of the pre-computed gradients stored in the texture.
*   **Time Complexity:** The rendering time is dominated by the texture resampling (hardware accelerated) and the CPU shading/compositing.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires texture memory proportional to the volume size ($N^3$ voxels).

*   **When to use:** When high-quality view-dependent shading is required, and the hardware supports 3D texture mapping but lacks sufficient post-texturing LUT capabilities or when dynamic lighting changes make pre-shading impractical.
